source: Official 55-trophy list, verified 19 Nov 2026 from GTABase and Outputlag (agree exactly on all 55 names, descriptions and grades) and the kit starter data

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy first — this one pops automatically when the last of the 54 lands. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the whole roadmap in this guide. Expect around 200 hours across the story, the side strands and the big grinds.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the pause menu's Progress tab. You need every robbery including 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, every underwater discovery, gold at all 42 Shooting Range challenges, wins at all 14 Top Fun locations, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. The partial counts are 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Track it all under Progress and mop it up after the story — nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from before it starts, in case you want to go back and replay the ending freely afterwards. It pops when the credits roll.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up; the map marks every Stunt Spot and Progress > Activities > Stunts tracks your count. The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. 100% completion wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges unlock as you explore; use a steady weapon, take your time on the timed lanes, and re-run any challenge until gold. Progress shows how many golds you still need.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — follow a security van to its vault, and hand a bag to your partner because the haul is too heavy for one character. Expect 4 stars every time and up to $205,000 per vault; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — the in-game trophy counter under Progress is the honest check. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3, and save first.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — scan the world with WAiNK and check the collections tab to see which sets are close to complete. Finish any three sets; the rest are optional.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK it at 100 locations: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB. Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35) and Sculptures (23) plus No Flusher tags all count. Point it at anything that glows when you scan — 100% completion only needs 100 scans, the same as this trophy.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Gone Fishing'. It is an early story mission — just follow the story and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophy — it pops when Chapter 2 begins, so keep playing the main missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy — it pops after the mission 'Welcome to Vice City', at the start of Chapter 3. The name is censored as 'T**s' in the public trophy lists, and we use it as published.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy — it pops after 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life', as Chapter 4 begins.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy — finish the chapter's final mission and it pops at the chapter boundary.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run'. Story trophy — play the main missions in order and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Story trophy — a main-mission completion, no extra requirement beyond finishing the heist itself.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Child's Play'. Story trophy — play the main missions in order and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Headliners'. Story trophy — play the main missions in order and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Story trophy — play the main missions in order and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Story trophy — play the main missions in order and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when he texts her an address in Belville. Five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is about 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up treasure. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later; track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's 5 jobs run from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break (Chapter 2); the 5th, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets the Key Cloner ('Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'): deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and better condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only: after 'Here, Kitty Kitty' (Chapter 3), destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then finish 'Shut Down the Labs'.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break (Chapter 2) when he texts Jason; the first hunt, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason — a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers this trophy is not confirmed yet, and 100% completion needs all 15 Target Decks, so work through the decks and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. One of each is enough — no wins needed except the race.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, one win each. 100% completion wants all 42 races, but the trophy only needs one win per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40. The same race twice does not count — vary the events you enter.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', he texts you and marks a fishing spot; play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play the 3 games on the TV at home (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) or Bang For Your Buck on an arcade cabinet around Leonida — finishing any one game pops it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, the morning after 'Down to Earth', disappears after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends. Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters (possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. It is not yet confirmed whether the Chapter 1 spot is required — treat it as required and do it early.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick; pick the easy ones first. 100% completion needs 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so they are the reliable way to get one; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3) are close together — hit them in sequence. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop; if it does not, rob a 4th.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan vehicles with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them, so stand next to a busy road and scan everything that passes. 100% completion wants 200 of 277 scans.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is clicking both sticks while aiming; fill Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline extends it), then use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) and use it on the locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Find the note with the safe code in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Box the truck in, or stick a sticky bomb on its back doors. A bank vault robbery + escape counts too.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. The quickest way is by plane; sweep the state in a grid and watch the map fill in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, shown as yellow map icons. Progress > Gangs keeps the count. 100% completion needs all 39 operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. 'Credit Check' (Meet Raul's Crew, Chapter 3) gets you the Dye Pack Jammer; then rob banks — bank vault jobs and Payday Loans — and sell the marked bills to fences. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so it accumulates across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it; it accumulates naturally across a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (after 'Daily Driver', Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app; take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first only cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space, and each registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — airfield-parked planes do not count. Gates E3/E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, then get about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Go to Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base. Get in a Rhino tank and stir up trouble until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description is 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach' — the exact spot and steps have not been confirmed by any guide yet. Our best reading: find a bar or cocktail spot overlooking Ocean Beach and order a drink there. This guide will be updated when a source confirms it — no invented method is given here.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description is 'Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style' — no guide has confirmed which showroom or the exact steps yet. Our best reading: drive a car out through the front of a vehicle showroom. No invented method is given here; this guide will be updated when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, first marked by 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (Chapter 2). Three valuables inside: a luxury watch (southeast office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (northeast table), and a safe (northeast hallway — bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia (pause menu > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story, train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Rack up 500 Criminal Profile actions. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI) to watch the count climb. Most players get this without trying — but note that an irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so do not push toward it deliberately.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description is 'Second time's the charm' — no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Our best reading is that it relates to failing and retrying something a second time. No invented method is given here; this guide will be updated when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description is 'What the hell just happened?' — no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Our best reading is that it comes from a strange or paranormal encounter somewhere in Leonida. No invented method is given here; this guide will be updated when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description is 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' — no guide has confirmed the exact setup yet. Our best reading: knock down bowling pins (or people) with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. No invented method is given here; this guide will be updated when a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
